purpose: Proposed A-based UI concept boards; not adopted production assets or game screenshots

page1.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-resolution coherent professional GAME UI DESIGN SYSTEM presentation board for Banish, using provided Image A as the strict visual reference: ivory subtly textured paper, restrained double edges, jade green tactile painted buttons, deep teal Chinese typography, delicate ink-landscape/lotus accents, warm hand-painted isometric village setting. This is a FULL INTERFACE CONCEPT BOARD, not a sprite atlas and not implemented-game evidence. Landscape 3:2 board with 4 clearly separated detailed screens, all sharing exactly one art direction and component family. Top row two larger desktop views: (1) ordinary gameplay with compact resource HUD at top and map occupying most of screen, minimal collapsed guide; (2) building selection and placement with UNIFIED RIGHT-SIDE workspace containing building catalog, selected warehouse illustration, concise costs and cancel/confirm controls, NO bottom-left duplicate catalog. Bottom row: (3) direct resource gathering mode: map foreground with tree/stone highlights and subtle rectangular area selection, a small compact floating '采集树木 · 拖动框选' hint and exit only; ABSOLUTELY NO confirmation dialog or construction panel in gathering mode; (4) portrait mobile layout with compact top resources, map and bottom build tray, touch-friendly controls. Small footer component strip demonstrates consistent normal/selected/disabled/pressed jade and ivory buttons, paper panel corners, selected item frame, illustrated wood/stone/food/population resource icons. Display real high-quality raster-art surfaces with paper grain and nuanced edge highlights, not generic CSS rectangles or flat dashboard UI. Preserve map visibility and hierarchy; sparse meaningful Chinese labels such as '粮仓','建造','取消','人口','用工上限'. No walls of tutorial text, no paragraphs, no floating unlabelled decorative clutter. Do not reproduce reference's accidental garbled Chinese. Keep concise readable labels. Compose entire polished coherent screen suite, not just palette swaps; fine edges, consistent icon style and scale. A-inspired art but the new map may use rustic timber village compatible with existing Banish sprites. Do not claim this is a screenshot. Add a small tasteful title 'Banish · 青玉界面设计' and '界面方案'.
